reason: Reviewed-equivalent. degrade() appends eight copies of a phrase drawn from the text itself, so the word count strictly rises while the distinct count cannot rise - the score strictly falls on every accepted round. An unfiltered lineage of one or more rounds therefore always has final strictly below its first sample; final === first is unreachable, and < versus <= decide identically on every reachable input. No test can kill it; equivalent, not test-theatre.
